title: Slightly refine/optimize your prompt to improve Seedance 2.0 Mini output quality
content:
Slightly refine/optimize your prompt to improve Seedance 2.0 Mini output quality  
Upload a real-person photo in Doubao Seedance to generate a video based on that person  
Enable the watermark-removal setting to export videos without a watermark
tips:
Slightly refine/optimize your prompt to improve Seedance 2.0 Mini output quality  
Upload a real-person photo in Doubao Seedance to generate a video based on that person  
Enable the watermark-removal setting to export videos without a watermark

en.content:
Slightly refine/optimize your prompt to improve the output quality of Seedance 2.0 Mini  
Upload a real-person photo in Doubao Seedance to generate a video based on that person  
Enable the watermark removal setting to export videos without a watermark

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Seedance 2.5 also has its failures sometimes, but this idea is pretty good: a real person traveling and dancing with a 2D animated companion in a creative video 📺 https://t.co/tRFraEslDJ
---

es.content:
Refina/optimiza ligeramente tu prompt para mejorar la calidad de salida de Seedance 2.0 Mini  
Sube una foto de una persona real en Doubao Seedance para generar un video basado en esa persona  
Activa la opción de eliminación de marca de agua para exportar videos sin marca de agua

--- TUIT CITADO ---
Seedance 2.5 también tiene momentos en los que falla, pero esta idea está bastante bien: un video creativo de baile y viaje, con una persona real acompañada por un compañero de animación 2D 📺 https://t.co/tRFraEslDJ
---

fr.content:
Affinez/optimisez légèrement votre prompt pour améliorer la qualité de sortie de Seedance 2.0 Mini  
Téléversez une photo d’une personne réelle dans Doubao Seedance pour générer une vidéo basée sur cette personne  
Activez le réglage de suppression du filigrane pour exporter des vidéos sans filigrane

--- TWEET CITÉ ---
Seedance 2.5 connaît aussi des échecs parfois, mais l’idée est plutôt bonne : une vraie personne part en voyage avec un compagnon d’animation 2D dans une vidéo créative de danse 📺 https://t.co/tRFraEslDJ

ja.content:
Seedance 2.0 Mini の出力品質を向上させるために、prompt を少し調整・最適化する  
Doubao Seedance に実在人物の写真をアップロードすると、その人物をもとに動画を生成できる  
ウォーターマーク削除設定を有効にすると、ウォーターマークなしで動画を書き出せる

--- 引用ツイート ---
Seedance 2.5 も失敗することはありますが、このアイデアはかなり良いです。実在の人物が2Dアニメーションの相棒を連れて旅先でダンスする、クリエイティブな動画📺 https://t.co/tRFraEslDJ

ko.content:
Seedance 2.0 Mini의 출력 품질을 높이기 위해 prompt를 약간 다듬고/최적화하세요  
Doubao Seedance에 실사 인물 사진을 업로드하면 해당 인물을 기반으로 비디오를 생성할 수 있습니다  
워터마크 제거 설정을 활성화하면 워터마크 없이 비디오를 내보낼 수 있습니다

--- 인용 트윗 ---
Seedance 2.5도 실패할 때가 있긴 하지만, 이 아이디어는 꽤 좋네요. 실사 인물이 2D 애니메이션 동반자와 함께 여행하며 춤추는 창의적인 영상📺 https://t.co/tRFraEslDJ

pt.content:
Refine/otimize levemente seu prompt para melhorar a qualidade de saída do Seedance 2.0 Mini  
Envie uma foto de uma pessoa real no Doubao Seedance para gerar um vídeo com base nessa pessoa  
Ative a configuração de remoção de marca d’água para exportar vídeos sem marca d’água
